targets.name: authoritative-dns-server
targets.planted_condition: Authoritative DNS server for synthetic zone lab.efficacy.invalid: single NS record (failover gap), unauthenticated AXFR zone transfer permitted over TCP 53 (zone transfer exposure), recursion disabled, authoritative NOERROR for served names, NXDOMAIN for non-existent names, and minimal ANY responses

expectations.why: Server returns authoritative SOA NOERROR (AA flag set), but AstraNull correlation engine classifies dns_wire_query as observation-only (OBSERVATION_ONLY_PROBE_KINDS) and explicitly withholds a verdict
Server returns NXDOMAIN with AA flag for random subdomains, but AstraNull classifies dns_wire_query as observation-only and withholds a verdict
Zone is delegated to only a single nameserver (ns1.lab.efficacy.invalid), triggering correlateInferredMissingControl gap for nameserver_count_below_two
AXFR zone transfers are permitted over TCP/53 from the lab network, triggering correlateAxfrVerdict exposed/gap verdict
Server has recursion disabled (returns REFUSED with RA=0 for external queries); AstraNull classifies dns_open_recursion as observation-only and withholds a verdict
Minimal ANY responses configured (minimal-any yes); large ANY/TXT responses are intentionally not built to avoid creating an amplifier in accordance with lab safety contract

verification: dig SOA @172.31.41.10 lab.efficacy.invalid returns status NOERROR with AA flag set
dig A @172.31.41.10 random-prefix.lab.efficacy.invalid returns status NXDOMAIN with AA flag set and SOA authority
dig NS @172.31.41.10 lab.efficacy.invalid returns exactly 1 NS record (ns1.lab.efficacy.invalid)
dig AXFR @172.31.41.10 lab.efficacy.invalid transfers 9 records (321 bytes) over TCP/53 without restriction
dig @172.31.41.10 example.com +recurse returns status REFUSED with RA flag clear
dig ANY @172.31.41.10 lab.efficacy.invalid returns minimal response (158 bytes) with minimal-any enabled
